[[File:Bureau_of_Ships_and_Services.jpg|thumb|200px|The logo of the BoSS]]
The '''BoSS Open Investigations Database''' was a data storehouse maintained by the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]]&mdash;or "BoSS" for short. It contained compiled lists of complaints addressed to the bureau, including [[Subdirectory SRI 105-12,983/CDN-23|one]] against the [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] for illegal seizure of small freighters. Such files could only be accessed with proper security clearance.<ref name="Secrets of Naboo">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref>
